scope: Android 15 emulator ARM translation plus three native Windows clients, direct NSD/DTLS to PC; no relay

checks.name: Release Android client discovers the PC and joins three Windows players over enrolled DTLS
Ordinary Android touch movement reaches the server and all three Windows views
Dragging on Android fills and pours the single shared bucket; all clients see the result
Android travels to Creek and back while the three other players stay in Garden
Backgrounding Android detaches only that player; a Windows sibling keeps changing the world
The same Android process automatically rejoins and receives the sibling changes
Force-stop/relaunch retains Keystore pairing, re-enters the same world, and preserves the original solo save
